_**Agent (default)**_

Here’s what was going wrong:

**This repo has no root `package.json`.** The only Node project is **`website/`** (Docusaurus). Running `npm start` or `npm install` from the repo root makes npm look for `/Innerflect_Operational_Intelligence_System/package.json`, which does not exist, so you get `ENOENT`.

**What to do:**

```bash
cd website
npm install
npm start
```

That runs the Docusaurus dev server (`docusaurus start`). Use Node **20+** (see `engines` in `website/package.json`).

**Note:** There is a **`package-lock.json` at the repository root** (untracked in git). It was almost certainly created by running `npm` in the wrong directory. It isn’t used by this project; you can delete that root `package-lock.json` if you want to avoid confusion. The real lockfile is `website/package-lock.json`.
